### 📓 Docs Drift Check
⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/src/data/field-scale.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files. Nothing else in this diff resolved to a documentable surface (no symbol, route or SDK anchor derived from **1** changed package(s)).

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/src/data/field-scale.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **138** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 53fd35e3e3a0b18b790ab79bd2c65f353e11ab65` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `97a757c2162d44ea4b86c4d340b50d8ab2bc4acb`
Local-runs: none

PR #21449 (card #21183). Net diff `origin/main...97a757c216`: one file, `packages/spec/src/data/field-scale.ts`, +25 / -1, every changed line a ` * ` line inside the module docblock's `number` bullet. Inputs read: the card body and both of its comments (claim 5957645758, dev report 5958445882), ruling 5933283974 on objectui#11254, the PR body and file list, the check-runs on this head, and read-only context on `origin/main` `53fd35e3e3`, on objectui at the `.objectui-sha` pin `89cad75d5570`, and in the published `@objectstack/spec@17.6.0` tarball. Isolated reviewer; the dispatch order and the seat's own conclusions were not read.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept set and public surface: no change.** The 26 changed lines are all comment lines in the detached module-level docblock (head lines 71 to 95). No schema, key, export, type or runtime moves; `AnalyticsResultResponseSchema`, `resolveFieldScale` and `FieldScaleMeta` are untouched. Right.
- **"That rule binds TODAY only the computed results whose inputs the renderer sees: the grid summary footer ... and the `object-metric` tile's `min` / `max`."** Right at the pin. `plugin-grid/src/useColumnSummary.ts` `widestFractionDigits` (line 216, applied at 567) rounds the footer's `number` result to the widest decimal count among the values it read; `plugin-dashboard/src/ObjectMetricWidget.tsx` `inferredFormat` returns `widthPattern(ownFractionDigits(entered), false)` for `min` / `max` (line 352). objectui PR #11375's merge `b149617e6f` is an ancestor of the pin (`git merge-base --is-ancestor`, exit 0). The exclusive "only" holds too: the dataset-bound face does not follow the rule (③, out-of-scope reading).
- **"A server-side `sum` / `avg` is not one of them ... `AnalyticsResultResponseSchema`'s column metadata (`@objectstack/spec/api`) carries `format` / `currency` / `percentScale` and no width."** Right. `data.fields[]` on `origin/main` (`api/analytics.zod.ts:94-130`) declares `name`, `type`, `label`, `format`, `currency`, `percentScale`, `builtinAggregate` and nothing else; `api/index.ts:66` re-exports `analytics.zod`, so the `@objectstack/spec/api` attribution is right. On the producer side, `service-analytics`'s `enrichResultColumns` and `withDeclaredMeasureFormats` write `label`, `builtinAggregate`, `format` (copied from the measure), `currency`, `percentScale` and `type`; neither reads a field `scale`.
- **"The `object-metric` tile still shows it as a whole number."** Right: `inferredFormat` falls through to `'0,0'` at line 354 when no `format` is authored, `resolveFieldScale` answers `undefined`, and the aggregate is not `min` / `max`.
- **"The dataset-bound tile, given no measure `format`, prints an integer answer as it is and rounds any other to at most two decimals."** Right: `DatasetWidget.tsx` calls `formatMeasure(value, f?.format, f?.currency, f?.percentScale, displayLocale)` (lines 1239, 1356, 1734, 1770), and `@object-ui/core` `utils/dataset-format.ts:403` reads `Number.isInteger(v) ? String(v) : formatNumberInLocale(v, locale, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 })` on the no-`format` arm.
- **The ruled end-state A and its trigger.** Right, in the ruling's own words: "the analytics result reports the width. Its column metadata carries the widest decimal count among the values the server read, or the declared `scale` when there is one, and the `object-metric` tile rounds to that"; "The trigger is the first first-party producer: a tile or dataset measure doing `sum` / `avg` over a `number` that declares no `scale` and whose author wrote no `format`. Then A is built in one go. ⛔ No new decision card." The docblock spells the tile as `object-metric`, which is the card's spelling and the tile the ruling's own reading names (`ObjectMetricWidget.tsx:354`). The paragraph frames A as "ruled" and says "Nothing is built before its trigger", so no end-state sentence reads as a present-tense delivery.
- **The two declared channels.** Right, and scoped per face. A field `scale` is said to reach the `object-metric` tile through `resolveFieldScale`: true (line 342, under `fieldUnitApplies`, which `sum` / `avg` / `min` / `max` satisfy). The text does NOT say `scale` reaches the dataset-bound tile; it names the measure's `format` as "the only channel that reaches that face", which is exactly what the service copies (`analytics-service.ts:2850`: `if (f.format == null && m.format) f.format = m.format;`). No sentence tells an author to declare `scale` where `scale` does nothing.
- **Protocol vs runtime.** No sentence claims more than the runtime delivers: the paragraph narrows the A′ guarantee to the two faces that honour it, states the gap per face, labels A as ruled and deferred, and names the declared remedies. Each citation (pin `89cad75d5570`, ruling 5933283974, batch 261 item 4, letter A deferred, 「其他四张同意」) matches its source. The pin is cited as "measured at `.objectui-sha` pin `89cad75d5570`", which `packages/spec/scripts/check-objectui-pin-citations.ts` classifies as HISTORICAL (a dated measurement) and not ASSERTING, so a later pin bump does not falsify it and the sentence sets no trap; the sha equals today's pin, and objectui is cited by file and symbol with no line numbers.

### ② Semver level

- `Clause-②: no`, no arm. Right: no accept-set change.
- **`skip-changeset` is CONFIRMED on this head.** The card and the dispatch asked for a `patch` changeset "since the docblock ships in the published types". That premise is false, measured on three channels, none of them a local run:
  1. `packages/spec/package.json` `files[]` is `dist`, `json-schema`, `liveness`, `prompts`, `llms.txt`, `README.md`, `src/**/*.zod.ts`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `api-surface`, `spec-changes.json`. `field-scale.ts` is not a `*.zod.ts` file and there is no `.npmignore`, so the source file is not packed.
  2. `tsup.config.ts` sets `sourcemap: true` under `esbuildOptions: dropSourcesContent` (`scripts/tsup-drop-sources-content.mjs`: `options.sourcesContent = false`), so no shipped map carries source text.
  3. The published `@objectstack/spec@17.6.0` tarball (registry `time.modified` `2026-10-02T03:03Z`, read over HTTPS, not built): the pre-existing module-docblock text "What an ABSENT" and "Why a resolver and not a Zod default" is in 0 files; the same file's exported-declaration TSDoc "The decimal places this field displays" is in 2 (`dist/data/index.d.ts`, `dist/data/index.d.mts`); no `field-scale*` file is shipped; 0 maps under `dist/` carry `sourcesContent`. The new paragraph lives in the same detached block as the text that does not ship, so the declaration emit that drops one drops the other. The tracked `files[]` members on the head (`api-surface`, `llms.txt`, `prompts`, `liveness`, `json-schema`, `README.md`, `spec-changes.json`) contain none of the docblock text either (`git grep` on the head); the one other hit for "What an ABSENT" is the barrel comment at `src/data/index.ts:289`, a paraphrase in a file `files[]` does not ship.
  So the diff publishes nothing from any released package, which is the one case AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3 reserves `skip-changeset` for; a `patch` entry would have put a CHANGELOG sentence in front of consumers about text none of them receive. The dev's measurement is reproduced independently here, and this at-tier PASS is the confirmation the seat's rule asks for.
- `Check Changeset` on this head: success.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Changeset removed (dev deviation 1).** Answered in ②: the removal is right and `skip-changeset` is confirmed.
- **Card premise holds on one face only (deviation 2).** Confirmed at the pin. The card's and the ruling's "the tile keeps its whole-number pattern" is the `object-metric` tile (the ruling's own reading is `ObjectMetricWidget.tsx:354`); the dataset-bound tile with no measure `format` rounds a non-integer `sum` / `avg` to at most two decimals (`dataset-format.ts:403`). The docblock states each face as the pin does, so the dev corrected the card's generalisation without departing from the ruling.
- **objectui shallow-clone fetch into a private ref (deviation 3).** No tracked change in either repo: `git status --porcelain` is empty in both `objectstack` and `objectui`; objectui carries no `refs/os-dev/*` and no ref naming `21183`; its HEAD reflog last moved at `2026-10-01T14:53Z`, before the dev's run, and its branch list is unchanged; `.git/shallow` holds one boundary commit and `FETCH_HEAD` records the bare-sha fetch of the pin. The object store grew; nothing tracked moved.
- **No merge of `main` (deviation 4).** Confirmed: the three commits since base `d7d5b4f96a` (`535d1d25ab`, `b79301000c`, `53fd35e3e3`) touch neither `packages/spec/src/data/field-scale.ts`, `packages/spec/src/api/analytics.zod.ts` nor `.objectui-sha` (`git diff --stat` over those paths is empty), and the PR is mergeable against `53fd35e3e3`.
- **`open_questions`: none declared, none found.**
- **`out_of_scope_findings`: the dataset-bound tile's `min` / `max` round to two decimals.** Reading only; ⛔ nothing filed from this seat. Confirmed: `formatMeasure` does not read the aggregate, so a `min` / `max` over a no-fixed-width `number` with no measure `format` takes the same `maximumFractionDigits: 2` arm, a constant, which is the shape A′ (ruling 5791809146) refuses by name. The docblock already excludes this face ("only ... the `object-metric` tile's `min` / `max`"), so the protocol text does not over-claim. It is the same family as Q2 of ruling 5933283974 (`GroupRow`'s `toFixed(2)`, recorded as "D, a recorded A′ gap" to be shaped when a producer appears), and there is no first-party `min` / `max` producer on `d7d5b4f96a`. Escalated to the seat: decide whether this gap gets a findable carrier (a note on objectui#11254 beside Q2, or a card) rather than living only in the PR's acceptance notes. The ruled end-state A, a width on the analytics column, would cover this face when built.
- **Check-runs on this head, final read 2026-10-02T18:31Z:** 39 check-runs, all completed: 32 `success`, 7 `skipped` (`Auto Label`, `Check PR Size`, `Check Changeset` duplicate run, `Console Pin Gate`, `Build Docs`, and both `Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in)` runs, each skipped by its path filter or opt-in), 0 failed, 0 still running. The named gates (`Lint & Repo Gates`, `Type Check · source gates`, `Type Check · workspace`, `Type Check · consumer gates`, `Spec property liveness`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check Changeset`, all six `Test Core` shards) concluded `success`. These conclusions are the gate verdicts; nothing was run locally.
